Hi Emma —

Really enjoyed the discovery call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive/demo with your infra and ML leads.

Call recap (5 bullets):
- Primary goal: validate latency and throughput for short-burst workloads (predictive inference) and assess multi-tenant isolation needs.
- Data residency: HeliosAI needs EU data-at-rest guarantees and audit logging in the short term.
- Expected QPS: ~50 sustained, peaks to 400 for training sync windows.
- Success metric for demo: 200ms p95 on 4k-context gen in a dedicated pod.
- Stakeholders to join next: Kai (infra), one engineer from modelops (TBD).

Scheduling ask: To be respectful of everyone across US/EU/APAC, I built a short "time-tiling" proposal — rotating demo slots so the same folks don't always fall outside working hours. Attached is a 1-page matrix and some candidate windows. Shortlist below (all times in UTC):

Option A — US-evening / EU-morning rotation- 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 17:00 CET) — 60 min
Option B — EU-late morning / APAC-early evening- 09:30 UTC (10:30 CET / 19:30 JST) — 60 min
Option C — APAC-friendly slot (rotating to cover US occasionally)- 00:30 UTC (16:30 PT previous day / 09:30 SGT) — 60 min

Please reply with 1) preferred option, 2) who from HeliosAI will join (Kai + ?), and 3) any hard constraints. If none of the slots work we can propose a rotating weekly cadence instead.

I attached the PDF with a visual matrix and notes on what we'll demo (prefix caching, batching profiles, and quantization tradeoffs). Vivek is copied to help with technical scheduling and SLO discussion.

Thanks —
Karthik
